chapterInfo.content:
28
Daa afɔdeɛ
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2#Lew 21.6 Hyɛ Israelfoɔ no na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: M’ayɛyɛdeɛ, m’aduane a wɔde bɔ ogya afɔdeɛ ma no yi ehwa hwanhwam ma me no, monhwɛ na momfa mmrɛ me ne berɛ a ɛsɛ mu.
3 # Eks 29.38-42 Na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Ogya afɔdeɛ a momfa mmrɛ AWURADE nie: Nnwanten mma mmienu a wɔadi afe afe a wɔdi mu na wɔmfa mmɔ da koro hyeɛ afɔdeɛ daa. 4Adwammaa baako na fa bɔ anɔpa, na fa adwammaa baako no bɔ anwummerɛ deɛ. 5#Lew 2.1 Na fa esiam olonka abupɛn du mu baako yɛ aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔde ngodua aba a wɔasie ngo susutoa abupɛn nnan mu baako afɔre. 6Ɛnyɛ daa hyeɛ afɔdeɛ a wɔhyehyɛeɛ wɔ Sinai bepɔ soɔ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam a ɛyɛ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ. 7Na n’ahwiesa susutoa abupɛn nnan mu baako nka adwammaa baako ho. Kronkronbea hɔ na hwie nsa a wɔhwie no ma AWURADE. 8Na adwammaa a ɔtɔ so mmienu no, fa bɔ anwummerɛ deɛ, na fa aduane afɔdeɛ ne n’ahwiesa ka ho sɛ anɔpa deɛ no ma no nyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.
Homeda afɔdeɛ
9 # Mat 12.5 Na homeda deɛ, nnwanten mma mmienu a wɔadi afe afe a wɔdi mu ne aduane afɔdeɛ esiam olonka abupɛn du mu mmienu a wɔde ngo afɔre ne ɛho ahwiesa. 10Homeda biara hyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛka daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne ɛho ahwiesa no ho ne no.
11 # Num 10.10 Na mo abosome foforɔ mfitiaseɛ nso, momfa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE: Anantwinini mmienu ne odwennini baako, nnwanten mma nson a wɔadi afe afe a wɔdi mu; 12#Num 28.20, 28; 15.2-13 na aduane afɔdeɛ esiam abupɛn du mu mmiɛnsa a wɔde ngo afɔre nka nantwinini baako ho, na aduane afɔdeɛ esiam abupɛn du mu mmienu a wɔde ngo afɔre nka odwennini baako ho, 13na aduane afɔdeɛ esiam abupɛn du mu baako a wɔde ngo afɔre nka odwennini baako ho, ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam a wɔhye ma AWURADE ne no. 14Na ɛho ahwiesa, bobesa susutoa fa nka nantwinini biara ho, na susutoa abupɛn mmiɛnsa mu baako nka odwennini no ho, na susutoa abupɛn nnan mu baako nka adwammaa biara ho. Yei ne bosome biara hyeɛ afɔdeɛ, afirinhyia abosome no mu. 15#Num 28.22 Na wɔmfa ɔpapo baako nso mmɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ mma AWURADE nka daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho ne ɛho ahwiesa ho.
Twam afahyɛ afɔdeɛ
16 # Lew 23.5-14 Na bosome a ɛdi kan da a ɛtɔ so dunan no yɛ AWURADE Twam. 17Na bosome no ara da a ɛtɔ so dunum no yɛ dapɔnna, nnanson na wɔnni apiti paanoo. 18#Num 28.25-26 Da a ɛdi kan no monhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara; 19na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE, anantwinini mmienu ne odwennini baako ne nnwanten mma nson a wɔadi afe afe; monhwɛ sɛ wɔdi mu; 20#Num 28.12 ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ, esiam a wɔde ngo afɔre abupɛn du mu mmiɛnsa nka nantwinini baako ho, na abupɛn du mu mmienu nka odwennini no ho, 21na abupɛn du mu baako nka nnwammaa nson no mu biara ho; 22#Num 28.15 ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ papo baako a wɔde bɛpata ama mo; 23monyɛ yeinom nka anɔpa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛyɛ daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho. 24Saa ara na nnanson no mu da biara momfa aduane mmɛbɔ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE; wɔnyɛ yei mpae daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne ɛho ahwiesa no so. 25Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no, monhyia nhyia kronkron. Monnyɛ adwumaden biara.
26 # Lew 23.15-21 Na sɛ mo adapɛn afahyɛ duru a, aduanekan da a mode mo aduane foforɔ afɔdeɛ rebrɛ AWURADE no, monhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara; 27na momfa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mmra na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam mma AWURADE: Anantwinini mmienu ne odwennini baako ne nnwanten mma nson a wɔadi afe afe; 28ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ, esiam a wɔde ngo afɔre abupɛn du mu mmiɛnsa nka nantwinini baako biara ho, abupɛn du mu mmienu nka odwennini no ho, 29abupɛn du mu baako nka nnwammaa nson no mu koro biara ho; 30#Num 28.15 ne ɔpapo baako a wɔde bɛpata ama mo; 31monyɛ yei ne ɛho ahwiesa no nka daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ no ho; monhwɛ sɛ wɔdi mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hyɛ Israelfoɔ no na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: M’ayɛyɛdeɛ, m’aduane a wɔde bɔ ogya afɔdeɛ ma no yi ehwa hwanhwam ma me no, monhwɛ na momfa mmrɛ me ne berɛ a ɛsɛ mu.
Na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Ogya afɔdeɛ a momfa mmrɛ AWURADE nie: Nnwanten mma mmienu a wɔadi afe afe a wɔdi mu na wɔmfa mmɔ da koro hyeɛ afɔdeɛ daa. Adwammaa baako na fa bɔ anɔpa, na fa adwammaa baako no bɔ anwummerɛ deɛ. Na fa esiam olonka abupɛn du mu baako yɛ aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔde ngodua aba a wɔasie ngo susutoa abupɛn nnan mu baako afɔre. Ɛnyɛ daa hyeɛ afɔdeɛ a wɔhyehyɛeɛ wɔ Sinai bepɔ soɔ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam a ɛyɛ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ. Na n’ahwiesa susutoa abupɛn nnan mu baako nka adwammaa baako ho. Kronkronbea hɔ na hwie nsa a wɔhwie no ma AWURADE. Na adwammaa a ɔtɔ so mmienu no, fa bɔ anwummerɛ deɛ, na fa aduane afɔdeɛ ne n’ahwiesa ka ho sɛ anɔpa deɛ no ma no nyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.

Na homeda deɛ, nnwanten mma mmienu a wɔadi afe afe a wɔdi mu ne aduane afɔdeɛ esiam olonka abupɛn du mu mmienu a wɔde ngo afɔre ne ɛho ahwiesa. Homeda biara hyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛka daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne ɛho ahwiesa no ho ne no.
Na mo abosome foforɔ mfitiaseɛ nso, momfa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE: Anantwinini mmienu ne odwennini baako, nnwanten mma nson a wɔadi afe afe a wɔdi mu; na aduane afɔdeɛ esiam abupɛn du mu mmiɛnsa a wɔde ngo afɔre nka nantwinini baako ho, na aduane afɔdeɛ esiam abupɛn du mu mmienu a wɔde ngo afɔre nka odwennini baako ho, na aduane afɔdeɛ esiam abupɛn du mu baako a wɔde ngo afɔre nka odwennini baako ho, ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam a wɔhye ma AWURADE ne no. Na ɛho ahwiesa, bobesa susutoa fa nka nantwinini biara ho, na susutoa abupɛn mmiɛnsa mu baako nka odwennini no ho, na susutoa abupɛn nnan mu baako nka adwammaa biara ho. Yei ne bosome biara hyeɛ afɔdeɛ, afirinhyia abosome no mu. Na wɔmfa ɔpapo baako nso mmɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ mma AWURADE nka daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho ne ɛho ahwiesa ho.

Na bosome a ɛdi kan da a ɛtɔ so dunan no yɛ AWURADE Twam. Na bosome no ara da a ɛtɔ so dunum no yɛ dapɔnna, nnanson na wɔnni apiti paanoo. Da a ɛdi kan no monhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara; na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE, anantwinini mmienu ne odwennini baako ne nnwanten mma nson a wɔadi afe afe; monhwɛ sɛ wɔdi mu; ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ, esiam a wɔde ngo afɔre abupɛn du mu mmiɛnsa nka nantwinini baako ho, na abupɛn du mu mmienu nka odwennini no ho, na abupɛn du mu baako nka nnwammaa nson no mu biara ho; ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ papo baako a wɔde bɛpata ama mo; monyɛ yeinom nka anɔpa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛyɛ daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho. Saa ara na nnanson no mu da biara momfa aduane mmɛbɔ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE; wɔnyɛ yei mpae daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne ɛho ahwiesa no so. Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no, monhyia nhyia kronkron. Monnyɛ adwumaden biara.
Na sɛ mo adapɛn afahyɛ duru a, aduanekan da a mode mo aduane foforɔ afɔdeɛ rebrɛ AWURADE no, monhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara; na momfa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mmra na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam mma AWURADE: Anantwinini mmienu ne odwennini baako ne nnwanten mma nson a wɔadi afe afe; ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ, esiam a wɔde ngo afɔre abupɛn du mu mmiɛnsa nka nantwinini baako biara ho, abupɛn du mu mmienu nka odwennini no ho, abupɛn du mu baako nka nnwammaa nson no mu koro biara ho; ne ɔpapo baako a wɔde bɛpata ama mo; monyɛ yei ne ɛho ahwiesa no nka daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ no ho; monhwɛ sɛ wɔdi mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
